verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is a changelog entry showing Paddle checkout can turn on Pix, a Brazilian local payment method, including recurring Pix Automático mandates set up at checkout. That makes it a capability of Paddle's own checkout integration, but nothing in the pack covers digital wallets or BNPL. Missing for 10: documented Apple Pay support, Google Pay support, bank-redirect methods (e.g. iDEAL/Bancontact), BNPL options, an explicit statement that all methods work through the same checkout integration, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration

citations.quote: Turn on Pix to accept subscription payments from customers in Brazil with a recurring Pix Automático mandate that customers set up at checkout.
